scripts.deploy: pnpm build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore:indexes --project wannabe-game
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore:indexes --project wannabe-game --dry-run
scripts.start: pnpm build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting --project wannabe-game
scripts.emulators:start:e2e: pnpm --dir functions build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:functions:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "pnpm --dir functions run test:emulator"
scripts.test:functions:round-actions:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "pnpm --dir functions run test:round-actions:emulator"
scripts.test:functions:room-lifecycle:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "pnpm --dir functions run test:room-lifecycle:emulator"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm run test:rules && pnpm run test:functions:emulator
